text: 财政部发布离岸信托个人所得税政策口径问答。 问：居民个人在装入环节未缴纳个人所得税的，财产原值如何调整？ 答：根据《关于离岸信托个人所得税有关事项的公告》第三条以及第十七条规定，由于财产装入离岸信托时市场价值低于财产原值或者装入环节税款超过追征期，居民个人未缴纳个人所得税的，财产原值不调整为装入时的市场价值，仍按个人取得财产时的价格确认财产原值。
text_en: The Ministry of Finance released a Q&A on the policy interpretation of individual income tax on offshore trusts. Q: How is the original value of property adjusted if a resident individual has not paid individual income tax at the contribution stage? A: According to Article 3 and Article 17 of the Announcement on Matters Concerning Individual Income Tax on Offshore Trusts, if the market value of the property at the time it is contributed to an offshore trust is lower than the original value of the property, or the tax at the contribution stage exceeds the recovery period, and the resident individual has not paid individual income tax, the original value of the property shall not be adjusted to the market value at the time of contribution, and shall still be confirmed at the price at which the individual acquired the property.
